# Menu 263 (save enhanced model) on a PMX model: SaveEnhancedModel writes
# PMD only and refuses it with a box, writing nothing; the model keeps its
# path. A PMD model still saves.
load model chain8.pmx
save pmd refused refused.pmd
load model .\lips.pmd
save pmd saved.pmd
select model chain8
save pmm after.pmm
